data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 紫晶穹顶下的花嫁
data.description: 【精灵天宫结界·黄昏】十香穿上为她准备的纯白婚纱，紫黑长发与大蝴蝶结在浮空花瓣间轻轻飘动；她把捧花举到鼻尖闻了闻，发现自己真的要走向誓约时，紫瞳里满是坦率而灿烂的期待。
data.location: crystal spirit cathedral above the city
data.action: 浮空花瓣间捧花闻香后迈向誓约，紫瞳里满是坦率期待
data.lighting: violet sunset filtered through crystal panels
data.mood: 纯真而热烈的誓约期待
data.promptProse: Tohka Yatogami from Date A Live wears a luminous white bridal gown with a large violet ribbon, crystal embroidery and a sheer veil. She stands beneath the crystal dome holding her bouquet close as floating petals circle the hem. She looks from the flowers to the viewer with open wonder, then takes one delighted step forward when the ceremonial lights bloom across the sky. violet sunset filtered through crystal panels.
